title: Alt-tabbing to Discord or OBS mid-game counts as a break
body:
While I play, held proactive remarks (and the briefing, which goes through the same engine) wait for a natural break: alt-tabbing away from the game (`foreground.js` `isAwayFromGame`, read by `proactive.js`'s `flush`). Any other app in front counts, including Discord and OBS, so switching to Discord mid-call to talk to people makes Mana speak a held remark right then.

What I want:
- Discord (stable/PTB/Canary) and OBS in front don't count as leaving the game.
- The list is configurable: `MANA_GAME_COMPANION_APPS` (comma-separated process names) replaces the default.
why: A small behaviour change in foreground.js (an allow-list of apps that do not count as a break), with a unit test against a pure function.
